# NexRoute 0.5.0

Major interactive control, automation, diagnostics, networking, and resilience release.

## Arrow-key interface

- the primary console no longer asks for numeric menu choices;
- Up/Down arrows move the `>[+]` selection, Enter opens an item, and Escape returns;
- all main menu sections and actions were renamed in both English and Russian;
- beginner and advanced interface modes, light/dark themes, accent colors, language auto-detection, and hotkeys were added.

## Updates

- `[+] Check Update` performs the complete stable update flow;
- the user confirms installation with `Y`;
- the package is downloaded, SHA-256 verified, backed up, installed, post-update checked, and the new NexRoute instance is opened automatically;
- automatic checks remain non-destructive and never install without confirmation;
- GitHub build provenance attestations can be verified from NexRoute when GitHub CLI is available.

## Strategy intelligence

- Strategy Lab history, comparison, scoring, sorting, and recommendations;
- automatic installation of the best measured strategy;
- latency, jitter, packet loss, download-rate, YouTube, Discord, and Telegram readiness probes;
- favorites, last-working strategy, automatic failover, and per-service strategy mapping.

## Operations and networking

- continuous health monitor, restart-loop limit, service availability panel, notifications, and tray controls;
- DNS diagnostics and provider selection with plain DNS, DoH, and DoT modes;
- active adapter/network profile handling, provider detection, reset and repair operations;
- IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR validation, A/AAAA resolution, and IPv6 readiness diagnostics.

## Management and support

- backup manager with selection of a specific rollback point;
- configuration export/import and custom service/strategy editors;
- command preview and validation;
- conflict checks for VPN, antivirus, firewall, and extra WinDivert installations;
- logs, filtering/search, diagnostic ZIP, error catalog, local statistics, stability charts, and JSON/CSV export.
